PatternDefinition

A pattern definition repeats an item as the tile of pattern colors, which fill and stroke items with it, see color.pattern: a Raster for image patterns, or any other item for vector patterns. As with symbol definitions, the item is removed from the scene graph, and all pattern colors that use the pattern share it, so they change along with it.

Constructors

PatternDefinition(item[, options])

Creates a pattern definition.

    Options:

  • [options.tile] {Rectangle} the rectangle that is repeated, the bounds of the item by default
  • options.spacing: Size — the gap between the tiles — default: 0

    Parameters:

  • item: Item — the item to repeat, which is removed from the scene graph and becomes the pattern’s tile content
  • options: Object — optional

    Returns:

  • PatternDefinition

Properties

project

The project that this pattern belongs to.

Read only.

    Type:

  • Project
item

The item that the pattern repeats. Unlike the items of symbols, it isn’t moved to 0, 0, so the tiles are at its own coordinates.

    Type:

  • Item
tile

The rectangle that is repeated, in the coordinates of the pattern’s item.

    Default:

  • the bounds of the pattern's item

    Type:

  • Rectangle
spacing

The gap between the tiles, horizontally and vertically.

    Default:

  • 0

    Type:

  • Size

Methods

clone()

Returns a copy of the pattern, with a copy of its item.

    Returns:

  • PatternDefinition
equals(pattern)

    Parameters:

  • pattern: PatternDefinition

  • Boolean — true if they are equal, false otherwise
